session_id.description: Optional session identifier used to continue an existing conversation.

message.description: Operator prompt sent to the agent runtime.

user_id.description: Normalized user identifier propagated from the identity layer.

request_id.description: Correlation identifier shared across portal, gateway, and runtime.

input_modality.description: Voice-readiness contract (SPEC-022 R-2): modality is metadata only. It never changes policy, auto-allow, or HITL outcomes, and can never approve or deny a parked confirmation.

model.description: Optional model selection (SPEC-024 R-3): a model id from GET /api/v1/models, relayed verbatim to agent-service. Metadata only — it never changes policy or HITL outcomes.
